crossRefs.note: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

translations.web: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
translations.bsb: But now that there are no further opportunities for me in these regions, and since I have longed for many years to visit you,
translations.kjv: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
translations.asv: but now, having no more any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come unto you,
